verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent Studio and Insights docs show agents ground answers in the customer's own knowledge (Help Center, FAQs, policies) and that Insights lets users 'view knowledge sources, systems accessed' behind an answer, which supports source attribution. However, there's no evidence of user-facing citations/links to specific source articles shown directly in the end-user chat answer itself (only an internal/admin-facing trace view), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this grounding-with-citation behavior. Missing for 10: end-user-facing citation display in answers, independent verification of source-accuracy, and detail on how source attribution appears to the end customer rather than just internal reviewers.
